notes:
Stream pickers use a consistent frosted panel, including over supported embedded video. The list counts available streams and keeps View more streams and Close together. A title-matched landscape banner appears when suitable art is available.

Home gives a single followed event the full row and lets you swipe through multiple events. Large score carousels have directional cues. The player shows current programme details across the main pages. Tap the information card or its Info button to read the full details.

Tested on Android phone and TV emulators, including an in-place phone upgrade from build 460681. Secure video uses a readable fallback. The existing picture-in-picture limitation remains: switching apps through Overview can leave the player unpinned.
